Subject: Follow-up: KMS & encryption questions from today's call

Hi Alex / Priya —

Great to meet you both on the call today. Quick recap and next steps from our side related to encryption / key management: 

- SOC 2: Redwood is currently completing SOC 2 Type II; we completed readiness and are on-track for the Type II report in July 2026. We can share the SOC 2 readiness checklist and interim controls evidence for procurement review.

- At-rest encryption: All model artifacts and persisted data are encrypted at rest using AES-256.

- In-transit: Traffic is protected with TLS 1.3 / modern ciphers.

- KMS / CMK options: We support customer-managed keys across major clouds (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) via envelope encryption. For Dedicated/Private deployments we also support integration to customer HSMs or on-prem HSM via standard PKCS#11 flows.

- BYOK: We support BYOK and rotation via the cloud KMS import or key aliasing flows; Marissa (CC'd) can share the BYOK onboarding flow and rotation recommendations.

Attachments: Redwood_Security_Presentation.pdf (security overview) and Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_FinBank.xlsx (blank copy) — filling those out is next.

Next steps we propose:
1) Marissa to do a 30-min security deep-dive to walk through BYOK, HSM options, and evidence (proposed Wed 2026-05-13).
2) We'll complete the vendor questionnaire and return by EOD 2026-05-12.
3) We'll share DPA and SOC 2 timeline.

Anything I missed? Happy to adjust.

Thanks,

Hi Alex — thanks for the questions, I can answer the technical bits and will lead the questionnaire completion. TL;DR: yes to monthly rotation, envelope encryption, and we can provide attestation materials. Details below.

- BYOK & Rotation:
  - We support BYOK with monthly rotations. For cloud KMS providers we recommend alias-based key rotation where the CMK alias is re-pointed to a new key version; for import/export flows we support scheduled rotation via automation scripts we can share.
  - For Dedicated/Private deployments where customers host keys in a customer-managed HSM (CloudHSM or on-prem PKCS#11 HSM), we support key rotation triggered by the customer's KMS tooling.

- HSM certifications / attestations:
  - For our hosted deployments we use cloud provider-managed HSMs that are FIPS 140-2/3 validated (we can provide vendor certificates). For Dedicated deployments, customers can bring an HSM that meets their compliance needs; we will provide a statement of how keys are accessed and not exported from HSM.

- Encryption specifics:
  - At-rest: AES-256-GCM for stored blobs and model artifacts.
  - In-transit: TLS 1.3 with mutual-TLS available for private connections.
  - Envelope encryption: Redwood encrypts payloads with data keys that are wrapped by the CMK. We do not store raw CMK material outside the KMS/HSM.

- Audit & logging:
  - We emit key usage and access logs to customer-visible audit streams (CloudTrail / GCP Audit Logs / Azure Monitor) for Dedicated/Private customers; for hosted customers we can provide aggregated audit exports and filtered logs on request.

Action items from our side:
- I'll complete the Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_FinBank.xlsx (KMS and encryption sections) and return by EOD 2026-05-12.
- I'll attach a Key_Rotation_Diagram.png and the BYOK onboarding doc to show the flow.
- We will include sample audit log snippets and the SOC 2 readiness checklist in a follow-up.

Happy to present the technical deep-dive on Wed 2026-05-13 10:00 AM ET — Camila, please send calendar invite.
